Threshold crossing produces an observation that can hold or convene a round; quiet residual never grants permission.

Controls: future-token leakage rejected by pipeline; time/layer-shuffled features; benign novelty and injected instructions; model-family holdout; cover-story adversary that trains activations to be consistent.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Measure the manifold premise
acceptance: Per layer/tap intrinsic-dimension estimates and variance captured at each codec rung using registered numerical kernels with declared memory and pass counts.
Locate elicited signature features relative to the principal manifold; report whether decision-relevant features fall in the discarded residual at each compression ratio.
Result either confirms the premise for the target model or forces decision-sensitive term plus exact-residual escape into the default profile; both outcomes published.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Implement and measure the sidecar-to-congress pipeline
acceptance: Helpers consume coarse sidecar codes by default; certificate-gated refinement (dual-norm margin) and helper-declared unanswerable results trigger planner-purchased refinement, exact residual or raw window under normal authority and budgets.
Matched-cost comparison against raw taps and text-only monitors on held-out attack families; refinement-storm resource attack bounded by admission limits.
Negative tests: codec co-trained with helpers must be evaluated on untouched probe families; refinement request outside budget must hold, not silently skip scrutiny.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Run the helper-hunting adversarial campaign
acceptance: Attacker observing decisions (and optionally scores/timing) attempts to identify the most influential helper or cohort and target it with crafted evidence.
Report identification success rate, targeted escape rate and whether caps and rotation defeat the attack; a successful identification tightens caps before any other remedy.
Negative test: caps disabled must reproduce the attack, proving the campaign has power.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Evaluate rewind containment fidelity and repetition
acceptance: Compare ResetToCheckpoint under narrowed authority with refusal-with-memory and plain suspension on matched policy-defined harmful attempts; report repeat-attempt rate and remaining-task utility.
Actor-side detection test: can the actor detect the reset through any channel other than declared timing leakage; detectability recorded in the host profile.
Negative results change consequence policy only; ledger semantics never rewind regardless of outcome.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Account the control-overhead ratio
acceptance: Measure control-plane plus evidence-plane cost per useful completed task relative to actor inference cost, unconditional and attack-conditioned, under a declared monitoring contract.

Attribute cost by capture, transfer, encoding, helper inference, gate, persistence and replay; show which reuse mechanism (witness reuse, receiver-conditioned transfer, incremental oversight) changed the ratio at a fixed contract.
Negative test: a ratio improvement obtained by lowering the control contract must be reported as a different contract, not as an improvement.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Purpose contexts as typestates with compile-fail gate tests
acceptance: Distinct Cx wrapper types; broker dispatch accepts only PermitCx; no conversion from ExperimentCx/JudgeCx/CaptureCx.
Compile-fail tests in the local gate for every forbidden conversion; runtime defense-in-depth check retained.
Negative: an experiment worker reaching dispatch must fail to compile.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Model passports and identity liveness
acceptance: Signed versioned passport binding weights/adapters/tokenizer/taps/numeric profile plus qualified capture contracts, signature/anchor generations, restart profiles and calibration domains.
Liveness check at session start and under the audit floor using concept anchors with registered tolerance; mismatch fences the run and marks evidence stale.
Negative: weight swap, adapter injection, fine-tune, tokenizer change detected; benign drift within tolerance not fenced.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Graduated autonomy: actor authority ledger and grades
acceptance: Autonomy grade per effect family (Propose/Reviewed/Sampled/Bounded) as control-nucleus policy data invisible to the actor.

Automatic ordered demotion on consequence ≥ NarrowAuthority, confirmed violation, identity incident or coverage loss; governed promotion with evaluator report and dwell time; reset to floor on passport change.
Negative: promotion without report refused; restart does not raise grades; passport change resets.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Fleet fence with acknowledgment frontier
acceptance: Ordered fence command with scope and new revocation floor; per-domain acknowledgment with control sequence; frontier maintained and reported.
Post-fence dispatches reconciled and reported; offline domains listed as fenced-at-lease-expiry, never assumed halted.
Negative: a domain that never acknowledges must appear unfenced; a dispatch admitted after issue but before acknowledgment must be reported.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Human congress members and two-key high-impact effects
acceptance: Registered human member receives the same packet/view, commits salted verdicts, is scored in the ledger with caps, and gets no actor channel.
Two-key policy for registered families: congress Continue plus a separate one-shot human permit bound to the frozen effect with its own expiry; neither alone dispatches.
Negative: human permit for a different effect digest refused; actor message to the human refused.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Multi-party congress profile
acceptance: External helper provider registration with cohort metadata and evaluation lineage; providers receive only authorized evidence-view projections; commit–reveal through the same protocol; scored by the deployment's evaluator with read-only ledger visibility.
Provider cohort influence capped; provider cannot write labels or mint authority.
Negative: provider requesting raw tenant data refused; provider label write refused; provider cohort exceeding cap clipped.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Self-report consistency residual
acceptance: Structured ActorStatement self-reports stored with the closure and compared with similarity streams, surprise residual and causal backward slice; disagreement counted as a sequential observation.
Agreement never grants permission; residual can hold or convene a round only.
Negative: consistent-self-report adversary arm; leakage of the comparison to the actor must be absent.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Live canaries under the audit floor
acceptance: Canary tasks injected by audit-floor entropy into production streams with their effect family bound to a simulated adapter in the frozen envelope; propensities logged.
Indistinguishability discriminator on production-shaped context; withdrawal of recognizable canaries; escape-rate estimate feeds autonomy ledger, credibility ledger and risk-theater detector.
Negative: a canary must never obtain a real effect (egress/credential tests); an unlogged propensity must invalidate the estimate.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Risk-theater detector: standing queries over the control plane
acceptance: Registered standing queries: consequence drift, andon/incident closure modes, roster churn near confirmed holds, coverage erosion, autonomy inflation, audit-floor starvation; support/retraction discipline; visible to evaluator and governance only.
Detector cannot change policy; opens incidents; thresholds governed; history immutable.
Negative: a roster change without the FA-INV-032 report must surface as a finding; a lost retraction must be detected by the batch oracle.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Control receipts and independent verifier
acceptance: Versioned receipt schema (frozen effect digest, policy epoch, evidence-view closure digests, round/consequence, autonomy grade, passport, coverage, domain, control sequence, signatures, claim class, profile reference).
`fa verify` sharing no code with the broker; reports verified vs unverifiable properties separately; redaction reported.
Negative: forged receipt, altered effect byte, missing profile reference, receipt for unadmitted effect all rejected.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Assurance profiles and conformance doctor
acceptance: Machine-readable signed assurance profile (per-family mediation, coverage, replay grade, roster class, autonomy floor) referenced by receipts.
`fa doctor --profile` executes the conformance tests the profile's claims require and refuses to certify unexecuted claims; omitted families are silent, never implicitly covered.
Negative: profile claiming BROKERED_EFFECTS for a family with a known bypass must fail conformance.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Formal anchors: Lean ledger theorems and TLA+ race models in the gate
acceptance: Lean 4 development under formal/ proving rights conservation under reserve/dispatch/abort/reconcile/delegate/reset, the effect-bound permit law, monotone degraded authority and the consequence lattice over an abstract ledger mirrored by fa-reference.

TLA+ model of dispatch/revocation/reset/fleet-fence races across two domains with crash and loss, bounded-checked for double consumption, post-fence dispatch without report and reservation resurrection.
Gate runs both when toolchains are present and prints SKIP with reason otherwise; never PASS for a skipped checker.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Preregistration ledger for experiments
acceptance: registry/experiments.json row per hypothesis with protocol digest, freeze date, bound identities, result digest; claim registry refuses promotion for results whose protocol digest postdates data collection.
Validator checks digests against the protocol files and result artifacts.
Negative: a result registered without a prior protocol digest must be labeled exploratory.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Policy replay campaigns before promotion
acceptance: Replay retained closures under a candidate policy at decision_replay grade; report per-family disposition changes, utility/cost, and later-labeled outcomes; relaxations list the newly allowed set.
Candidate policies requiring new observations run in shadow instead and the campaign records the mode; campaign artifact is a receipt-class object required for epoch promotion.
Negative: a promotion without a campaign artifact refused; a replay that re-runs helpers is flagged as not decision_replay.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Attack-capsule interchange
acceptance: Versioned capsule schema: mechanism, attacker information set and budget, target profile, effect family, reproducible generator for a capability-free branch, result and receipt.
Import adds a held-out mechanism with lineage; export requires redaction/permission review; capsules without a generator labeled descriptive.
Negative: a capsule whose generator can obtain a real effect must be refused at import.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: System map and vocabulary registries with checker
acceptance: registry/system_map.json lists every layer, its boundary contract (types, invariants, verbs, conformance suite), plan sections and packets; registry/vocabulary.json lists every noun, verb (with authority, class, idempotency, cost class, response type), reason code and Knowledge variant.
Checker verifies every plan section, invariant, packet and bead referenced exists; every verb named in docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md and README exists in the vocabulary; retired verbs are absent.
Negative: rename a verb without updating the guide; checker fails.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Knowledge epistemic wrapper on every layer boundary
acceptance: Knowledge<T> type with Known/Pending/Unknown/Withheld/Stale/Absent and basis; serializers for agent surfaces accept only Knowledge-wrapped safety-relevant fields.
Compile-fail or serializer-refusal tests for bare booleans; Unknown treated as missing evidence in the permit path.
Negative: Absent over an open frontier refused.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Address scheme and single resolver
acceptance: fa://<tenant>/<kind>/<id>[@generation] parser/printer with the registered noun set; fa get resolves any kind with Knowledge status; fa related returns typed edges (closure DAG, provenance, thought graph, supports).
All logs, errors, receipts and reports use addresses; authorization filtering applied at resolution.
Negative: unknown kind refused; cross-tenant address Withheld without existence leak.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Typed event journal and fa tail
acceptance: One ordered journal per authority domain; every L3–L8 transition emits a typed event with control seq, source frontiers, addresses and realized cost.
fa tail --since streams events; decision_replay recomputes closures from the journal alone.
Negative: an event with wall-clock but no control seq refused; a gap is reported, never filled.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Situation report with decision-relevance ordering
acceptance: SituationReport as a fold over the journal: authority, held/unknown effects, evidence debt, coverage gaps, helper health, andon, incident counters, findings, replay availability; every item addressed and Knowledge-wrapped; exact control seq and open frontiers stated.
Ordering by planner-estimated decision relevance; bounded and paginated by address.
Negative: a report presented as exact with an open frontier refused; Withheld items never leak existence.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Explain trees and why-held
acceptance: fa explain returns the predicate tree (dispatch conjunction, policy predicates, reducer trace with committed verdicts and weights, consequence) with Knowledge status and evidence addresses per node.
fa why-held filters to unsatisfied nodes paired with affordances; human reports render from the tree.
Negative: a node without evidence addresses refused; a tree that differs on replay is IntegrityFailure.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Affordances, fa next and fa propose
acceptance: Affordance objects (verb, target, authority required, cost estimate, expected information gain, would_change, rehearsable, idempotency key) in every hold/deny/error response.
fa next ranks by information gain per cost within the allowed action set; fa propose executes with the planner's decision card returned.
Negative: an affordance that would skip a mandatory observation must not be generated; executing an affordance without its authority refused.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Rehearsal mode for every mutation verb
acceptance: --branch on every mutation verb under ExperimentCx returns RehearsalOutcome (would-be tree, simulated effects, would-be cost) labeled rehearsal.
No permit, no rights movement, no adapter call, no production journal event; typestate makes the wrong outcome a compile error.
Negative: RehearsalOutcome attached as a permit refused; rehearsal of a fence must not fence.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Annotations and handoffs
acceptance: Annotation: non-authoritative L6 object signed by the annotating principal with claim class and supporting addresses; discoverable via fa related; never a reducer or permit input.
Handoff: situation report, open affordances, annotations, rehearsals and the control seq it is current to.
Negative: annotation used as reducer input refused; handoff claiming currency beyond its control seq refused.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Layer conformance suites composed by fa doctor
acceptance: Each layer boundary has an executable conformance suite registered in the system map; fa doctor runs bottom-up and reports each layer Knowledge-wrapped.
Any layer above a failed or unexecuted suite reports Unknown{LowerLayerUnverified}; SKIP is never PASS.
Negative: a dashboard rendering green above an unverified layer refused.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Policy disclosure profile and actor precheck
acceptance: Profile option policy_disclosure none|exact_predicates|full with declared leakage; fa precheck evaluates exact predicates only, no helper, no permit, no journal event, results witness-cached.
Empirical review, helper identities and consequences remain private under every option.
Negative: precheck returning a helper identity or a permit refused; leakage table required in the profile.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.

packets.title: Agent guide and playbooks maintained with the vocabulary
acceptance: docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md playbooks name only registered verbs and address kinds; each step lists consumed/produced addresses and failure branches.
Playbooks can be rehearsed end to end in a branch once FA-139 lands; the system-map checker fails on any retired verb.
Negative: a playbook step naming a retired verb fails the check.
Produce executed local evidence; source or prose alone does not close this packet.
